title: Log the swallowed exception in BulkMarkScreen._loadPreExistingCompletions's catch block

evidence.quote:
} catch (_) {
      // Non-fatal: if pre-tick loading fails just open with unticked state.

why: The B7 pre-tick feature (pre-checking previously-completed items when the bulk-mark screen opens) fails completely silently on any exception -- DB error, malformed hierarchy data -- with zero telemetry. If pre-ticking breaks in production (e.g. after a schema change), nobody will know; users will see every item as unticked and may re-mark (and re-earn siyum credit for) content already completed, with no log line to diagnose why.
recommendation: Log via AppLogger.instance.warning(event: ..., exception: e, stackTrace: st) before falling through to the unticked-state fallback, matching the pattern already used in _expungeRefs's .catchError a few lines below in the same file.
acceptance_criteria: a test that forces getContentForCurriculum/getCompletionsByCurriculum to throw asserts AppLogger.instance received a warning/error call
the log-less-catch half of the Rule-0 empty-catch checker (once shipped) flags any catch block in lib/ with no AppLogger call and no rethrow
